Four structures from CoRE MOF 2024's supporting-information subset, as
distributed in CoRE MOF Tools (CoREMOF/data/SI/CR.zip), unchanged:

  2019[Sm][sqc]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C8CE01430B, desolvated; CoRE: Sm open
  2019[Sm][sqc]3[FSR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C8CE01430B, with its solvent; CoRE: no OMS
  2020[In][hcb]2[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/D0SC01994A; CoRE: no OMS
  2021[Pb][llj]2[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/C9CC09664G; CoRE: Pb open (Pb is not
                            calibrated, so the Void does not check it)

G. Zhao, L. Brabson, S. Chheda, J. Huang, H. Kim, K. Liu et al., CoRE MOF DB:
a curated experimental metal-organic framework database with machine-learned
properties for integrated material-process screening, Matter 8, 102140 (2025).
